ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.

The right lobe is predominantly high-intensity white with sparse dark spots near the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel dark-intensity linear marks (rake marks) present on the mid-section of the left lobe and distal portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major tissue loss and irregular structural indentations along the trailing edge of both lobes, suggesting significant prior physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation distribution with a significantly higher density of dark-intensity clusters on the left lobe compared to the right lobe.
